releasePolicy: No main merge or container release until all required gates pass and documented unresolved scope is reviewed. Passing tests do not establish universal correctness.

workstreams.contract: Customer datasets, explicit expected output, semantic comparisons and bounded masks; visual checks require renderer integration.
Field-level input and formatter explanations; distinguish preflight evaluation from executed layout traces.
Explicit JSON Schema subset, assertions, sample data and TypeScript generation; unsupported schema constructs fail closed.
Carbone subset conversion with diagnostics and Crystal exported metadata inventory; no claim of arbitrary RPT compatibility.
Structured and text comparisons with explicit equality rules and bounded differences.
Hashed snapshot and asset bundle, environment identity checks, offline replay; hashes establish integrity, not authenticity.
Mandatory validators, immutable artifact snapshots, timeout/error quarantine and digest-bound evidence; machine PDF checks do not certify accessibility.
Pinned component versions, dependency validation, cycle detection and transitive impact analysis.
Bounded tabular report definition, filters and detail view, same selected snapshot for browser and template exports.
Provider-neutral candidate verification against customer tests, digest-bound review and stale-base rejection; no automatic model trust or publishing.

remainingAcceptance: Representative real customer templates and approved visual baselines
Microsoft Office repair-free opening on supported desktop versions
Independent accessibility human review for any accessibility claim
